column1: # Spending-history public-key extraction check; retrieved 2026-11-02 from mempool.space address chain_stats and mempool_stats.
# Zero spent outputs means no P2PKH spending script at that address from which to extract a key; it is not a claim about keys published elsewhere.
# Public keys were accepted only after local secp256k1 parsing and HASH160/P2PKH address validation. No private scalar is included.
